display_name: Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 2001 (Singapore): the third party's seat
seat: a person who is not a party to a contract but is named in it or benefits from it, asking on facts they can state whether they may enforce a term, whether the parties may still vary or cancel it, and what defences the promisor has
edition: 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation (Singapore Statutes Online plain-text rendering retrieved 2026-10-01; CRTPA2001.txt sha256 9aa9128ebe90d4c4e66542848a08a8451ac2f3baeb3d1cbbd50f93a220569e82). A converter-script rendering, not the official text.

scope.encoded: Every operative provision: ss 1 to 9 of the Act, with the two defined-term groups of s 2(7) and s 7(6), (7); the regulative rules s 3(1) SHANT, s 3(4) MAY, s 4(6) SHANT and s 6 MUST; a hand-gathered route for ss 1, 2 and 7; and a seat layer of 58 questions.
scope.not_encoded: Inert by reasons 1 and 2 of the brief only: the title page, arrangement of sections, long title, headings, s 1(1) short title, the Act's own commencement date, the legislative history, abbreviations, comparative table and page furniture. Other laws the text cites (Limitation Act 1959, Unfair Contract Terms Act 1977, Bills of Lading Act 1992, Carriage by Air Act 1988, Companies Act 1967, Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2005) and the Minister's orders under s 7(6)(b), (c) are inputs, not encoded.

dependencies.used_for: s 2(1) month and the counting of a period of months from a day, for s 1(2); the module returns NOTHING for months from a day
